title: Pipeline Decision Orchestrator — Reasoning at Every Decision Point
brief: Build PipelineDecisionOrchestratorEngine and replace all 22 HARDCODED + 56 HEURISTIC decisions across 7 pipelines with physics-backed optimal selection. Wire SmartToolSelector, CoolantStrategy, EntryExitStrategy, IntelligentSequencing, WorkholdingViability, CrossCamRecommender into all pipelines. Wire thermal, vibration, surface, wear, chip, thread engines. Add decision audit trail with XAI explainability. Wire AutoSpeedFeed, ProbeRoutineGen, SetupSheet, ToolROI.

units.title: PipelineDecisionOrchestratorEngine
units.description: Universal decision wrapper. For ANY pipeline decision: (1) identify candidates, (2) score across 5 axes (optimal/logical/safe/cost/robust), (3) select best, (4) generate justification, (5) log with alternatives. Wraps DecisionTreeEngine + XAIEngine + InferenceChainEngine.
units.closure_notes: PipelineDecisionOrchestratorEngine exists (937 LOC), API validated via CAMX-MS0.3-U01-PipelineDecisionOrchestrator.test.ts (47 tests passing). 12 decision categories, 5 scoring axes, objective modifiers, safety veto, justification/alternatives, audit log, batch/compare/prescreen all validated. Wired into UnifiedCAMPipelineEngine + ReasoningWiringEngine.

units.title: Decision taxonomy for 114 decision points
units.description: Classify all 114 decision points into 12 categories: tool_select, strategy_select, parameter_optimize, coolant_select, entry_exit_select, sequence_optimize, workholding_validate, controller_select, holder_select, coating_select, work_offset_select, safety_check. Each category has scoring rubric.
units.closure_notes: 114-point decision taxonomy built at src/data/pipelineDecisionTaxonomy.ts. 9 pipelines (PrintToProgram 22, Turning 14, MultiAxis 12, MillTurn 10, EDM 12, Grinding 10, Laser 10, Waterjet 10, QuoteToShip 14). 12 categories all covered. byPipeline/byCategory/byCurrentMethod/lookup/stats helpers. Current method ledger HARDCODED/HEURISTIC/DYNAMIC feeds retrofit debt for U-CAMX03..U-CAMX24. 44/44 tests passing.

units.title: Replace HARDCODED tool decisions
units.description: Wire SmartToolSelectorEngine into PrintToProgram, PartGeometry, CAMKernel. Search real 95K catalog instead of synthetic tools. Every tool decision uses 7-factor physics scoring with rationale[] output.
units.closure_notes: SmartToolSelectorOrchestratorAdapter (180 LOC) wires SmartToolSelectorEngine (46,590-tool catalog, 7-axis physics scoring) through PipelineDecisionOrchestrator decide() for category=tool_select. Adapter maps SmartToolResult 7-axis breakdown → orchestrator 5 pre_scores; orchestrator audit log captures every tool decision. 4 taxonomy entries flipped HEURISTIC → DYNAMIC: p2p.tool_select_rough/finish/drill, mx.tool_select_undercut. Test suite: 13 tests passing + 44 taxonomy regressions still green (57 total).

units.title: Replace HARDCODED coating/material decisions
units.description: CoatingSelectionLogic: ISO P→TiAlN/AlCrN, M→AlTiN/TiCN, K→uncoated/TiN, N→DLC/PCD, S→AlTiN/TiAlSiN, H→CBN/nanocomposite. Consider operation, speed range, coolant type.
units.closure_notes: CoatingSelectionAdapter (320 LOC) routes ISO-group-aware coating candidates (12 primary + 3 EDM wire) through PipelineDecisionOrchestrator. Thermal hard-filter (0.8× cutting_temp_c floor). 3 HARDCODED→DYNAMIC flips: p2p.coating_select, turn.coating_insert, edm.wire_coating. 21 new tests; 57 regression tests pass.

units.title: Replace HARDCODED engagement decisions
units.description: Optimize ap/ae by solving: maximize MRR subject to Fc ≤ 85% power, deflection ≤ tolerance/3, P(chatter) ≤ 15%, thermal ≤ limit. Uses Kienzle, deflection, stability lobes, Johnson-Cook.
units.closure_notes: EngagementOptimizerAdapter (290 LOC) enumerates ae/ap candidates from Sandvik/Walter envelopes (rough 30-70%/finish 5-30%), applies Kienzle force + Euler-Bernoulli deflection (50μm cap) + optional chatter SLD filter, routes survivors through PipelineDecisionOrchestrator. 2 HEURISTIC→DYNAMIC flips: p2p.engagement_optimize, turn.depth_of_cut. 12 new tests + 78 regression tests pass.

units.title: Wire CoolantStrategyEngine into all pipelines
units.description: Replace if/else coolant rules with CoolantStrategyEngine call. Material safety, 8 delivery methods, 9 fluid types, quantitative outputs.
units.closure_notes: CoolantStrategyAdapter (330 LOC) covers 4 domains (machining/EDM/laser/grinding). Catalog: flood, HPC-through-spindle, MQL, air, dry, dielectric (DI water + EDM oil), N2/O2/Ar/air laser gases, grinding-specific (flood/mist/creep-feed HPC). Scoring: chemistry-critical iso mismatch sinks safety by 0.55 for gas / 0.25 otherwise; HRSA flag penalizes MQL (-0.5); deep-hole L/D>5 boosts HPC perf. 4 DYNAMIC flips: p2p.coolant_mode, turn.coolant_method, gr.coolant_method, la.gas_select. 20 new tests + 90 regression tests pass.

units.title: Wire EntryExitStrategyEngine into all pipelines
units.description: Replace 1:1 entry/exit maps with physics-aware selection. 9 material profiles, geometry-aware helix/ramp/plunge cascade.
units.closure_notes: Shipped d1884c94bc (slot kilo claude-c0eb54b9). Wire scope: PrintToProgramPipelineEngine.generateCuttingMoves default-case (pocket/rough/finish/contour/slot — drilling/tapping canned cycles unchanged). New helper mapMaterialToEntryStrategy + extended generateCuttingMoves signature (backward-compat). Hardcoded helix Dc*0.3 + feed factors 0.5/0.3 replaced by EntryExitStrategyEngine.selectEntry(). R12 surfaces engine warnings AND method-mismatch as G-code comments. 11/11 vitest PASS. 2-reviewer scrutiny: Arm A PASS first round; Arm B FAIL→FIXED→PASS (P0: silent geometry regression — fallback helix radius halved → fixed Dc*0.6; P1: engine.recommended_method swallowed → fixed METHOD MISMATCH surface). U-CAMX23/U-CAMX24 cross-regression guard PASS. The broader "wire into ALL pipelines" scope (Turning/MultiAxis/MillTurn/EDM) is followed up in successor units.

units.title: Wire IntelligentSequencingEngine into all pipelines
units.description: Replace fixed priority tables with 33-rule topological sort + greedy TSP + thermal gap insertion.
units.closure_notes: Shipped 709745709f (slot kilo claude-c0eb54b9). Wire scope: PrintToProgramPipelineEngine.runFullPipeline post-process-plan, pre-chatter-check. New helper applyIntelligentSequencing maps PlannedOperation→SequenceableOp via stable ids, runs IntelligentSequencingEngine.sequence(), re-stitches with op_number rewrite 1..N. R12 fail-soft on throw/non-permutation/missing-id/duplicate-id. 11/11 vitest PASS. 2-reviewer scrutiny: Arm A PASS first round; Arm B FAIL→FIXED→PASS (P1: warnings swallowed → fixed via stage=intelligent_sequencing; P1: duplicate-id silent op-duplication → fixed via seenIds Set guard). Cross-regression U-CAMX07+U-CAMX24 PASS. Broader "wire into ALL pipelines" scope (Turning/MultiAxis/MillTurn/EDM) follows-up.

units.title: Wire WorkholdingViabilityEngine
units.description: Before accepting any operation plan, validate workholding via Coulomb friction model. SF < 1.5 → escalate.

units.title: Wire CrossCamRecommenderEngine for strategy
units.description: At every strategy selection point, call CrossCamRecommender with full physics scoring across 22+ strategies.
exit_conditions: CrossCamRecommender called for all strategy decisions

units.title: Smart WCS selection
units.description: G54 for single-setup, G54-G59 for multi-setup, G54.1 P1-P4 for tombstone, coordinate with pallet ID.

units.title: Smart safe-Z calculation
units.description: safe_Z = max_feature_Z + clearance + tool_change_clearance. No more hardcoded Z50.

units.title: Decision audit trail
units.description: Every pipeline output includes decision_log[] documenting every choice: decision_point, category, selected, score, alternatives[{option, score, why_not}], justification, physics_basis. Wire XAIEngine for feature importance.
exit_conditions: XAI feature importance on key decisions

units.title: Tests for decision orchestrator
units.description: 60+ tests: no HARDCODED decisions remain, every decision produces justification, audit trail complete, SmartToolSelector/CoolantStrategy/CrossCamRecommender called.

units.title: Wire thermal engines into program generation
units.description: For programs >30min: InverseThermalCompensationEngine for drift G-code, CuttingTemperatureEngine for overheat validation, ThermalFatigueEngine for insert life.

units.title: Wire vibration engines into strategy/parameter selection
units.description: ChatterStabilityLobeEngine for chatter-free RPM, ThinFloorVibrationEngine for thin walls, BarStockVibrationEngine for turning.

units.title: Wire surface finish engines into validation
units.description: Replace inline Ra=fz²/32r with SurfaceFinishPredictorEngine (runout, vibration, deflection). SurfaceLocationErrorEngine for dynamic prediction. SurfaceIntegrityPredictorEngine for subsurface damage.

units.title: Wire wear engines into tool life and batch planning
units.description: StochasticToolWearEngine for probabilistic life. ToolWearCompensationEngine for batch G-code offsets. CoffinMansonFatigueEngine for fracture risk. WearForceCompensationEngine for force increase.

units.title: Wire chip management engines
units.description: ChipBreakingEngine to validate broken chips. ChipMorphologyDiagnosticEngine for chip type prediction. Flag continuous chips (re-nesting risk).

units.title: Wire thread/hole/drilling engines
units.description: PeckDrillingOptimizationEngine for peck depths. ThreadMillingEngine for helical thread code. HolePatternPipelineEngine for bolt circles. DeepHoleDrillingPhysicsEngine for L/D>10.

units.title: ToolROIEngine
units.description: For every tool decision: (a) best from user crib with cost/part, (b) best from catalog at 3 price points (budget/standard/premium), (c) ROI: 'Buy X for $Y, saves $Z/part, ROI in N parts.'

units.title: Wire AutoSpeedFeedEngine into PrintToProgram
units.description: After P2P generates G-code, pass through AutoSpeedFeedEngine for per-block S/F. Then StabilityRPMRewriterEngine for chatter-free RPM.
exit_conditions: Per-block S/F on every cutting line

units.title: Wire ProbeRoutineGeneratorEngine into PrintToProgram
units.description: For features with tolerance < 0.025mm or Ra < 0.8um, auto-generate in-process probing cycles per controller format.

units.title: Wire SetupSheetFromGCodeEngine into PrintToProgram
units.description: Replace P2P inline setup sheet with full SetupSheetFromGCodeEngine (1156L). Professional setup sheet alongside program.
units.closure_notes: Wire shipped in 2f2c5b0ef5 (engine — bundled under CAM-EXHAUST-MS0/U-BRIDGE-WIRE-MASTERCAM via fleet auto-commit collision) + b15beba942 (16-case behavioral test — bundled under LIMA WIKI-WATCHDOG-PROBE-FIX similarly).
